name: Mridul Sharma
bio: I build software that helps people, then explain how it works. Passionate about teaching, learning, and using AI to work smarter.

building.label: Gusset
building.desc: Log one sentence a day and your engineering work-experience record builds itself, with an AI assistant along the way.

building.label: Switchboard
building.desc: Routes each step of an AI task to the right model, and escalates when a cheaper one isn't enough.

building.label: Sun Clock
building.desc: Your phone screen follows the sun: cool and bright in the morning, warm in the evening, deep red at night. Plus how your body clock reads light.

building.label: Vision Scan
building.desc: How a Tesla sees with only cameras, rebuilt on a phone. Walk around a room and watch AI fill it with 3D blocks. More phones, more cameras.

building.label: Fly Brain NPC
building.desc: A game character running on 867 neurons from a real fruit fly brain. Race it against a scripted NPC, or evolve a swarm.

building.label: EVantage
building.desc: EV charging that prices itself by the grid: cheaper when it's clean and quiet, pricier at the peak. My capstone, presented at UNB.

signoff: Plant a seed today, grow a better tomorrow.
